provenance: Combined learning curve. Points 1-4: first run (configs/rlbr_scale.json, init results/ppo_pilot.pt), stopped by the --max-usd guard at 4,940,938 decisions / 97,536 games. Points 5-7: resume (configs/rlbr_scale_resume.json) from that final checkpoint; totals = resume counts + 4,940,938 decisions / 97,536 games. The 4.94M checkpoint appears twice (local eval 0.0975, Modal eval 0.100): same seeds, so they should be identical in principle; the small gap matches the first run's local-vs-Modal differences (0.0825 vs 0.09 at 3M, 0.04 vs 0.06 at init). Resume restarted Adam (moments not saved); lr is constant 3e-4 (no schedule), so only the optimizer state reset. Resume training seed_base=1999 (seed=1) vs 999 in the first run, so no training game is repeated. Resume used games_per_input=16 (first run 8): only the map partition changes, training batches are the same given the seeds.
